# Loris Cuntreri

> Loris Cuntreri is a software engineer specialising in Rust and high-performance backends, with experience in Node.js, Deno, TypeScript and MongoDB. This site is his portfolio: professional background, open-source projects, and contact information.

Loris started programming in C++ in secondary school, completed a full-stack web development course, worked as a backend developer using Node.js/Deno and Rust at GoSport, and now works as an AI Data Trainer for SME Careers, training models to generate efficient Rust code.

## About

- [Home](https://www.loriscuntreri.com/): Portfolio homepage with a summary of why to work with Loris.
- [Curriculum Vitae (English)](https://www.loriscuntreri.com/en/Loris_Cuntreri_CV.pdf): Downloadable CV in English.
- [Curriculum Vitae (Italian)](https://www.loriscuntreri.com/it/Loris_Cuntreri_CV.pdf): Downloadable CV in Italian.

## Projects

- [AteBitEmu](https://git.loriscuntreri.com/marel/atebitemu): MOS 6502 emulator written in Rust that passes Klaus Normann's functional test.
- [SPUD](https://git.loriscuntreri.com/marel/spud_rs): Binary file format for databases, written in Rust.
- [LilDB](https://git.loriscuntreri.com/marel/LilDB): In-development database written in Rust, with CLI and gRPC interfaces.
- [LilDBSh](https://git.loriscuntreri.com/marel/LilDBSh): Shell client for LilDB.
- [Jay](https://git.loriscuntreri.com/marel/Jay): Early Rust project through which Loris learned much of the language.
- [WebSpocket](https://git.loriscuntreri.com/marel/WebSpocket): WebSocket library for Deno/TypeScript.
- [Git server](https://git.loriscuntreri.com/marel): All public repositories.

## Misarum

- [Misarum](https://misarum.it): Local AI assistant for Italian law that runs on your own infrastructure and indexes official Italian legislation.
- [Misarum demo](https://app.misarum.it): Demo application for Misarum.
